description: This file defines a servlet filter class 'CatalogUrlFilter' used for URL pattern matching and processing related to product and category URLs in an e-commerce application built on Apache OFBiz. It handles URL rewriting, trail building, and request forwarding for product and category pages within the catalog component.

classes.name: CatalogUrlFilter
classes.description: Servlet filter class responsible for URL rewriting, request forwarding, and trail management for product and category URLs in the catalog component of Apache OFBiz.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the filter with configuration parameters.

methods.name: doFilter
methods.description: Main method that processes incoming requests to handle URL rewriting, trail building, and forwarding.

methods.name: destroy
methods.description: Clean-up method for the filter (empty implementation).

methods.name: makeCategoryUrl
methods.description: Creates a URL for a category page based on request parameters or entity data.

methods.name: makeCategoryUrl
methods.description: Creates a category URL using provided entity wrapper, trail, and other parameters.

methods.name: makeProductUrl
methods.description: Creates a URL for a product page based on request data or entity data.

methods.name: makeProductUrl
methods.description: Creates a product URL given entity wrapper, trail, and other parameters.

methods.name: getDefaultLocaleString
methods.description: Returns the default locale string used in URL processing.

methods.name: setDefaultLocaleString
methods.description: Sets the default locale string used in URL processing.

methods.name: setRedirectUrl
methods.description: Sets the redirect URL in the filter.
